mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are waking up to beautiful clear skies and 61 degrees, with a feels-like temperature of 63, making it a great morning to visit Badger Prairie County Park under the waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona is highlighting local sustainability efforts. Apartment residents can easily compost by dropping off kitchen scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop. Meanwhile, the city is improving transportation sustainability with anti-idling ambulance tech, hybrid police fleet vehicles, and continuing recognition as a Bicycle Friendly Community.

Looking at our calendar, July 19th brings plenty of live music options to Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie, alongside the historic Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later in the week, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 20th, and do not miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In our weekly police recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle accident on Old PB and Whalen Road last Friday, July 10th. The bicyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Our local Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM today. When they open, you can treat yourself to the delicious Turtle flavor of the day. If you are planning for tomorrow, the flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
